scientific_role: Attach one fixed development lifecycle to every frozen V35 board-lot-affordability event. This is a mother-signal economic screen, not a portfolio replay or parameter search.

signal_scope.candidate_definition: Exactly the 1,047 Stage-A frozen event_id rows; no re-ranking, reselection, cooldown change, proxy change or membership change.

outcome_data.maximum_event_path: 126 global market sessions strictly after each frozen signal, additionally capped at 2021-06-30
outcome_data.2021_role: Path-completion buffer for late-2020 frozen signals only; no 2021 signal may enter.
outcome_data.path_completeness: The cap must provide at least 126 global sessions after the latest signal. Missing candidate paths fail closed; unsellable or invalid paths remain explicit non-completed outcomes.

outcome_attachment.entry: Inspect global market cal_idx signal+1 through signal+3 in order. Fill at the first legal, fully valid, non-upper-limit coordinate open. Never fill on the signal bar.
outcome_attachment.target: The first later same-lineage legal coordinate high at least 1.10 times entry exits at exactly +10% gross, subject to the frozen sellability check.
outcome_attachment.fallback: At the first same-lineage row with cal_idx strictly greater than entry_cal_idx+20, process the open before same-day high. Exit at target if sellable open is at/above target; otherwise exit at coordinate open. Only an unsellable open may defer to a later same-day legal target touch.

development_gate.if_failed: Keep later periods closed; no threshold rescue, parameter change or portfolio inference.
development_gate.if_passed: A pass is development evidence only and does not authorize any later-period read, chart phase or portfolio replay.

outputs.publication: same-parent temporary construction, complete audits, re-hash every bound input, then one atomic no-overwrite rename

prohibited: changing the Stage-A signal definition, thresholds, ranks, cooldown, direction, dates or candidate membership
same-bar entry, entry after signal+3, target/horizon/cost search, stop search or alternate execution
2021 signals, any row after 2021-06-30, or any 2022-plus read
chart construction, portfolio replay, threshold rescue or market-state filtering
overwriting any V35 Stage-A or existing Stage-B artifact
claiming independent confirmation or strict PIT-A
